title: Guest Towel Holder Countertop Stand 16.3-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection, Freestanding Towel Stand | Allied Brass
description:
Add convenient towel storage at the sink with this guest towel holder for the bathroom countertop. This freestanding towel stand features two arms to hold guest towels, hand towels, and washcloths close to the vanity area. Crafted from solid brass, it uses a heavy base to help reduce tipping and includes a felt pad to help protect countertop surfaces.

Highlights:
- Guest towel holder / towel stand for bathroom counters and vanities
- Two-arm design keeps towels organized and within easy reach
- Solid brass construction
- Heavy base helps prevent tipping
- Felt pad helps prevent scratching on the counter
- Part of the carolina collection to coordinate with matching pieces

Specs:
- Mounting type: Countertop (freestanding)
- Dimensions: 16.3-Inch L x 5.5-Inch W x 14-Inch H
- Weight capacity: 20 lb
- Product weight: 5.6 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Freestanding towel holder
- Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

A smart fit for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories.
